e4e92c0163c8.text: The BLUE plane was extracted from each exported TIFF. A 3 × 3 median filter was used for segmentation only, followed by a common threshold of >128 on the 0–255 export scale and 8-connected labeling. The bottom-right annotation rectangle (x ≥85% of image width and y ≥90% of image height) was excluded equally in every field. Eligible objects had area 200–2200 pixels, bounding-box aspect ratio ≤2.5, and object area/bounding-box area ≥0.4. Objects within 49 pixels of a frame edge or whose measurement neighborhood intersected the annotation exclusion were rejected. No watershed split was imposed on merged objects.

4783a22dfaaf.text: These rules define a conservative image-analysis subset, not a validated nuclear census. Segmentation has been visually inspected, but not benchmarked against independently annotated cell boundaries. Small touching nuclei or nuclear fragments can still pass these geometric filters, so an accepted object is not guaranteed to equal one cell. DAPI is a nuclear counterstain commonly used with fixed preparations. Here, fixation is confirmed and no permeabilization was performed; completeness and uniformity of nuclear labeling were not independently assessed. Fixed DAPI images do not recover the cells’ viability before fixation.

8ff822da164e.text: adds an explicit statistical specification, all three same-batch blank-field holdouts and the area-versus-object audit. These additions leave the original segmentation and primary thresholds unchanged.

69bffb61bccd.text: For each eligible object, the signal region contains its nuclear mask plus pixels within 12 pixels, assigned to the nearest blue connected component to limit sharing between adjacent objects. The local background is sampled 24–48 pixels from that object, excluding blue foreground; at least 100 background pixels are required. For RED and GREEN separately, the score is the signal region’s 90th percentile intensity minus the background median. Measurements use the original exported channel values, before the display adjustments.

5320f6640509.text: This nearest-DAPI expansion does not segment cell boundaries. Excluding blue foreground from the background ring also does not exclude every neighboring cell’s cytoplasm. Fluorescent cytoplasm within that ring can raise the estimated background and reduce an object's score, particularly in dense fields.

59e780cb2742.text: Regional mean-intensity traces and exploratory local-baseline ΔF/F₀ traces describe changes around the approximate presentation windows. UAS-GCaMP6f provides a calcium-sensitive reporter, but a normalized fluorescence change alone does not separate calcium-dependent responses from motion, bleaching, baseline drift or stimulus-delivery artifacts. Motion correction, background handling, independent animals and replicate consistency are not established by these files. The observation motivates a design question about converting biological fluorescence into data; it does not establish receptor specificity, validate the HEK293 OR/Orco–GCaMP system or demonstrate hardware performance.

d24ffcdb4c9a.text: The central limitation is the gap between an assay specification and a complete, reproducible execution record. The plate photographs document visible growth. Colony identities, miniprep measurements and gel documentation must still connect that record to verified plasmids. Mammalian-cell records must connect the construct, transfection condition, selection history and image acquisition settings to each experiment. The current electroporation specification and literature-informed G418 schedule should not be read as independently validated operating conditions.

1ac9bdeb2064.text: The next validation priorities are to complete the cloning evidence, document the actual transfection settings, establish host- and batch-specific selection controls, and evaluate reporter expression with appropriate cell-count and viability information. Functional fluorescence responses then require matched stimulus controls and independent biological replicates. Fly imaging can strengthen the project's biological context when its preparation and acquisition metadata are recovered; it remains a separate study rather than a substitute for these core tests.

e2f4567446aa.text: The three experimental tracks separately document cloning, HEK293 expression and odor testing, and exploratory fly brain imaging. Its value depends on keeping construct verification, expression, selection and sensing performance as distinct evidence requirements. The available methods support that progression without claiming completion of experiments whose records are still being assembled.
